DDEV

Built from github.com/ddev/ddev. Other DDEV sites are listed at ddev.github.io.

Documentation

ddev.github.io/ddev/docs/en/stable/ Stable documentation, for the current release. A backup copy of docs.ddev.com/en/stable/.
ddev.github.io/ddev/docs/en/latest/ Latest documentation, with unreleased changes from the main branch. A backup copy of docs.ddev.com/en/latest/.

Performance

ddev.github.io/ddev/perf/ Nightly benchmarks of ddev start, ddev utility rebuild, Mutagen sync, and a Drupal install on each supported Docker provider, to compare providers and catch slowdowns. See Docker Provider Performance, 2026.
ddev.github.io/ddev/perf/ci/ Run time of each CI workflow on GitHub Actions and Buildkite, to see when the test suite gets slower.
ddev.github.io/ddev/perf/ci/tests/ Run time of each Go test, to find slow and flaky tests.
github.com/ddev/ddev/actions/workflows/perf-start-time.yml A pull request check that fails when ddev start or ddev utility rebuild gets much slower than on the base branch. The times are in the summary of each run. See perf/README.md.

Docker Hub

github.com/ddev/ddev/actions/workflows/image-tag-cleanup.yml Finds image tags that no DDEV build needs any more, and deletes them on request. Each weekly run lists them, with the storage of each repository, in its summary. See Cleaning Up Unused Image Tags.
